Why buy a digital vignette for Austria online via the ADAC toll portal?
Immediate start of validity
The digital vignette is valid immediately upon purchase (if desired).
No service and processing fees
You only pay the vignette price and no service fees.
No delays or interruptions
No queuing and time wasted at petrol stations and toll stations.
Authorised online sales partner
The ADAC is an authorised online sales partner of ASFINAG.
Section toll routes in Austria
A13 Brenner motorway
On the Brenner motorway (A13), a section toll applies for the entire 25 kilometre stretch. A vignette is not necessary here. For a return trip (i.e. 2 single trips) a section toll of €25.00 is due.
BUY BRENNER SECTION TOLL
A10 Tauern motorway
As an important north-south connection within Austria, the A10 Tauern motorway between the Flachau and Rennweg junctions is subject to a section toll. The toll for a return trip is €30.00.
BUY TAUERN SECTION TOLL
More section toll routes in Austria
S16 Arlberg speedway
The S16 Arlberg motorway runs through the Arlberg tunnel and is subject to a section toll between the St. Anton and Langen junctions. No vignette is required for passing through the Arlberg tunnel. A return trip by car is €26.00.
BUY ARLBERG SECTION TOLL
A9 Pyhrn motorway
The A9 Pyhrn motorway is characterised by two toll sections: the Bosruck tunnel between Spiral/Pyhrn and Ardning and the Gleinalm tunnel between St. Michael and Übelbach. Both toll sections cost €38.00 (return trip), but it is also possible to purchase only one of the toll sections (Bosruck: €14.00 or Gleinalm €24.00, both return trips).
BUY PYHRN SECTION TOLL
A11 Karawanken motorway
The A11 Karawanken motorway runs from the Villach junction to the Slovenian border and includes a toll section between the St. Jakob im Rosental junction and the Slovenian border at Jesenice. This section is tolled by the Austrian ASFINAG only soutbound and is €9.00 per single trip.
BUY KARAWANKEN SECTION TOLL

Further and similar questions regarding digital section toll in Austria
Which section toll segments exist within Austria?
You will need to pay a section toll on the following motorway sections:
A13 Brenner motorway: The entire A13 is subject to a section toll
A 10 Tauern motorway: Between Flachau and Rennweg (Tauern and Katschberg tunnels)
S 16 Arlberg motorway: Between St. Anton am Arlberg and Langen am Arlberg (Arlberg tunnel)
A 11 Karawanken motorway - southbound: Between St. Jakob im Rosental and the national border in the Karawanken tunnel
A9 Pyhrn motorway:
Bosruck Tunnel: Between Spital/Pyhrn and Ardning
Gleinalm Tunnel: Between St. Michael and Übelbach
Depending on where you enter the motorway sections, you will also need a vignette as this is compulsory on all motorways and speedways in Austria.
Why do I have to pay a section toll despite having a valid vignette?
A vignette is compulsory for the use of Austrian motorways and speedways. The Austrian toll operator ASFINAG charges a section toll for particularly cost-intensive routes such as tunnels, bridges or mountain passes. This replaces the vignette requirement for certain segments of a motorway (see list below).
Note:
However, depending on how you access these motorway sections subject to the route toll, a vignette may be required. For example, when entering the A13 Brenner motorway via the A12 Inntal motorway, you need a valid vignette for using the A12 motorway in addition to the section toll for the Brenner.
Motorway sections subject to route tolls:
A13 Brenner motorway: The entire A13 is subject to a section toll
A 10 Tauern motorway: Between Flachau and Rennweg (Tauern and Katschberg tunnels)
S 16 Arlberg motorway: Between St. Anton am Arlberg and Langen am Arlberg (Arlberg tunnel)
A 11 Karawanken motorway - southbound: Between St. Jakob im Rosental and the national border in the Karawanken tunnel
A9 Pyhrn motorway:
Bosruck Tunnel: Between Spital/Pyhrn and Ardning
Gleinalm Tunnel: Between St. Michael and Übelbach
When does my section toll ticket become valid?
The digital section toll can be booked in the ADAC toll portal for one or two single trips and is valid immediately. A single trip is valid for one trip in one direction. It can be used once within 365 days from the date of purchase.
How can I cancel my digital section toll?
The digital section toll can be cancelled free of charge within 14 days of the booking date if the booked trip/ticket has not yet been used or redeemed.
Please note that if you book two section toll trips/tickets, you can only cancel both trips at once.
Cancellations can be handled by yourself in our Manage Order area.
-> Manage Order
How can I change the license plate number for the digital section toll?
You can change the license plate number for which you purchased the digital section toll free of charge, as long as the first trip/ticket has not yet been used or redeemed.
Changes can be made by yourself via our Manage Order area. Please have the order number and the email address you used when ordering ready.
-> Manage order
Order confirmation not received yet, but your trip is imminent.
If you have not received an order confirmation by email after booking a vignette or section toll for Austria, but your trip is imminent, please do the following:
Please use the validity check of the Austrian toll operator ASFINAG to check whether a valid vignette or section toll exists for your license plate number.
-> ASFINAG validity check
If yes
, then you can drive with peace of mind! You have successfully purchased a valid vignette and/or section toll via the toll portal and can drive through/to Austria.
If no
, then your order with us was not successful and there is no valid vignette or section toll for the license plate entered.
Please order a new vignette or section toll, otherwise you risk a fine (so-called replacement toll) of €120.
If, despite the unsuccessful order, the vignette or route toll price has already been debited by us, we will of course reimburse you.
Buy 1-Day and 10-Day vignettes for Austria online
10-Day Vignette Austria
The digital 10-Day Vignette with immediate validity allows you to drive on toll-compulsory motorways and speedways in Austria. The validity period of the 10-day Vignette begins on the 1st day of validity plus 9 additional calendar days. The 10-day Vignette costs € 12.80 for cars (incl. trailers) and € 5.10 for motorbikes.
Buy a 10-Day vignette for Austria online
1-Day Vignette Austria
A new vignette is now available in Austria: the digital 1-Day vignette (Daily vignette). It is valid for one calendar day from 00:00 a.m. - 11:59 p.m.. The 1-Day Vignette is available in the ADAC toll portal. The cost for a 1-Day Vignette for cars and motor vehicles up to and including 3.5 tonnes is €9.10 and €3.80 for motorcycles.
Buy a 1-Day vignette online
